observations: Photo 0 and Photo 1 show a black PlayStation 4 console with a 'Star Wars' theme sticker on top.
The console has 'SONY' and 'PS4' branding visible on the front.
Two controllers are placed on top of the console; one is silver and the other is black.
The controllers appear to be DualShock 4 style, with standard button layouts.
The console is placed on a wooden surface, with a yellow metal object and plastic bag in the background.
The console shows some dust and minor wear, especially on the top surface.
No games are visible in either photo.
The seller claims it includes 13 games, but none are shown.
